entry.notRun: no desktop: answers are recorded through recordHumanDecision as the desktop delivers them
entry.runs: human-gate/gate.mjs (humanGateDecision, recordHumanDecision, sessionLifeMark, unattended approval port), requests.mjs, store.mjs, session-grants.mjs (createSessionGrants with now/maxEntries/ttlMs), agent-room roomMemberSessionId, the live session store (setLiveSession), config updateSection

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.compare: mixdog-core-session src/session/k1_grants_replay.rs: one interpreter for the recorded logs; every step is done on the core and compared whole in recorded order: a decide's verdict written as Node's { decision, request, gate, remembered }, a choose's answered response, the grants and audit rows, the permission rows. Card fields (presented, normalized, fields, offered, grantActions) are the card a client is shown (room_approval tool_approval / normalize_tool_approval_request), taken at the keys humanRequestFields defines (the card also carries the queue's own name/args/cwd/reason fields); a response is the decision the approval book takes from a client's result (ApprovalBook::validate).
replay.entry: decide: mixdog_tools::policy::gate::decide over the facts and settings of mixdog_core_ports SessionGate (a live header per session; unattended runs and Allow all actions behind its GateEnv; the recorder's roster mailer/scribe as contact bots), the tool's own outbound_kind (the registered GithubTool; a connector tool by mixdog_mcp::outbound::outbound_kind with the empty annotations the recorder passed), the session's SessionGrants in the process SessionGrantRegistry. choose/answer: ToolPolicy::authorize of the call the last decide decided, the card answered through ApprovalBook::validate (a timedOut answer is the request's own timeout). Store: FileGrantStore on a temp directory stamped with the recording's held Date.now; AgentPermissions (mixdog-core-agents) for agentPermissions/setAgentPermission. The session-grant clock starts at the recorder's 1_000_000 ms and moves only by the recorded advances; a reset is a clear (header compaction.lastClearAt), an ended life a closed header. An answer whose recorded gate differs from the one decide produced (hook-ask 6, 8; session-grants 5, 6: the recorder forged remember/action to test recordHumanDecision) is answered on the card the core produced: the core records only its own plans; the observables after it are compared.

normalised.dataDir: <data> wherever it occurs (paths listed in normalised.paths)

replay.targetsCheckedAgainst: replay-k1-tools-scm: the replay calls each target

exclusions.session-grants case 4 field unknown: sessionLifeMark of a session id the store does not hold: the core builds a session's gate (SessionGate over the live header) only for a session it holds, so no life is read for an unknown id; the field is not compared
